text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"‘No rain lasts forever’...
...I really love that saying."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many losses keep piling up...
one day the skies will clear—and I'll see the sun, the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've been building up toward it
so that dream will come true!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Today's the day I clear away the rain clouds!
